{{Quote|You don't know much about bounty hunters, do you? We're not chatty.|[[Snoova]]|<ref name="SWGTCG:GHLS" />}}
In a '''skirmish''' at the [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Snoova]] lay in wait for a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who he had been told were looking for him. Snoova had backup in the form of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. When the spacers came near, Snoova ambushed them and pushed their leader into an alleyway, where the thugs were waiting. In the ensuing fray, Snoova was defeated and his crew fled. The Wookiee bounty hunter revealed to the spacers the information they sought: the location of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prisoner Snoova had turned over to another bounty hunter, [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]].<ref name="SWGTCG:GHLS" />
